findings.title: Live test failures
findings.body:
The `CI_HAS_DEPLOYED_RESOURCES` skip guard is removed, so `aci_user_assigned_live` now panics on `expect("IDENTITY_ACI_IP_USER_ASSIGNED")` whenever it runs in live mode without deployed resources.

`deployResources` defaults to `false`, and the post-provisioning script now returns early without publishing `IDENTITY_ACI_IP_USER_ASSIGNED` / `IDENTITY_AKS_IP` in that case. Any live pipeline run that uses the default template parameters (`AZURE_TEST_MODE=live`, `deployResources` unset) will therefore fail instead of skipping.

The same applies to `workload_identity_credential::tests::live`. Please confirm that the CI live matrix always sets `deployResources=true`, or keep a gate tied to `IDENTITY_DEPLOY_RESOURCES`.

findings.title: Live test failures
findings.body: Removing the deployed-resources skip makes `live` fail with a panic on a missing `IDENTITY_AKS_IP` in live runs where resources were not deployed. The post script no longer publishes this variable when `IDENTITY_DEPLOY_RESOURCES` is false.
